rationale: JAD1/JAD2 (M37 java wave #595): array READS are uses sourced to the enclosing METHOD (two-walks-one-owner family rule: calls attribute to the method, so reads agree); array WRITES (xs[i] = v LHS) are gated like every other managed-OO analyzer. This pin replaces the old #419 G1 contract that sourced reads to the class and treated writes as reads — both sides of the old pin were the defect the JAD wave fixed. Authored from the verified emission contract, probed against the fixed analyzer.
